resources.string: Build runs from King down to Ace in one suit: a complete run leaves the table. Tap a card to move it with the cards on top of it, and tap it again to try another place. Tap the deck to deal a new row.
Spades only. The easiest way to play, good for learning.
Spades and hearts. A little harder.
All four suits. A real challenge.
To deal a new row, every column needs a card. Move a card into the empty column first.
Tap the deck to deal a new row.
These cards are not in order of one suit, so they cannot move together.
There are no useful moves left and no cards to deal. You can undo some moves and try another way, or give up.
